text: {"summary": "The agent informed the customer about a pending EMI of 4500 rupees due on the 5th. The customer explained that their salary was late and they would pay by the 28th. The agent acknowledged and noted the plan to pay by the 28th.","key_points": ["EMI amount is 4500 rupees and was due on the 5th.","Customer's salary was late and they will pay by the 28th.","Agent acknowledged the plan and noted that payment will be made by the 28th."],"action_items": ["Customer to make the EMI payment of 4500 rupees by the 28th.","Agent to update the payment status once the payment is received."],"classification": "POSITIVE"}

{"summary": "The customer reports an EMI payment was made via UPI yesterday and requests the transaction ID. The agent asks for the transaction ID and will check and update the status. The customer will provide the transaction ID via WhatsApp.","key_points": ["Customer states they paid EMI via UPI yesterday and has a screenshot.","Customer provided a transaction ID starting with 'T2409' and will send it via WhatsApp.","Agent will check the payment status and update the customer."],"action_items": ["Customer to send the transaction ID (starting with 'T2409') via WhatsApp.","Agent to verify the payment status and update the customer accordingly."],"classification": "CALLBACK_REQUESTED"}

{"summary": "The customer reports a non-payment due to a product defect and requests no further calls. The agent acknowledges the complaint and will escalate it, but no payment commitment is obtained during this interaction.","key_points": ["Customer states they are not paying the overdue loan of 12,000 rupees.","Customer claims the product was defective and that nobody helped them.","Agent states the loan is separate from the product issue.","Customer requests not to be called again.","Agent will escalate the complaint."],"action_items": ["Escalate the customer's complaint to the appropriate department.","Update the customer's contact preferences to opt out of future calls.","Document the complaint details (non-payment due to product defect) for follow-up."],"classification": "CALLBACK_REQUESTED"}

{"summary": "The customer requested a callback at 6 PM due to being busy driving. The agent agreed to call back at 6 PM, establishing a scheduled follow-up.","key_points": ["Customer is currently driving and unavailable to talk.","Customer requested a callback at 6 PM.","Agent confirmed that a callback will be made at 6 PM."],"action_items": ["Place a callback to the customer at 6 PM as requested."],"classification": "CALLBACK_REQUESTED"}

{"summary": "The caller claims they are not Sunita Sharma and that the number is incorrect. The agent acknowledges the mismatch and notes the number exists in records under the wrong name. The caller requests updating the records to reflect the correct name. No payment or service action is involved at this time.","key_points": ["Caller states they are not Sunita Sharma and that this is the wrong number.","Agent confirms the number exists in records under the wrong name.","Caller requests updating the records to reflect the correct name (Sunita Sharma)."],"action_items": ["Update the records to reflect the correct name (Sunita Sharma) for this contact.","Verify and correct the contact details in the system to prevent future misdials."],"classification": "WRONG_NUMBER"}

The agent will retry later, and no payment or service details were discussed.","key_points": ["Call attempt to connect with the customer did not go through.","Agent indicated they would try again later.","No payment status or service details discussed in this exchange."],"action_items": ["Retry the call to connect with the customer at a later time.","Log the failed connection attempt in the CRM and schedule a follow-up attempt."],"classification": "CALLBACK_REQUESTED"}
